clue.text: Move into different shares as socialist tax is introduced

indicators.note: is introduced says the word is gets put into the middle of the other pieces

parts.note: red is the colour and nickname of a socialist
a tribute is a payment levied by a ruler, a tax
taken as written

explanation.surface: A left-wing government brings in a new levy to share out wealth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Red' is the standard crossword shorthand for a socialist, and a tribute was historically a levy paid to a ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: To share out again among new holders is to allocate the goods differently.

clue.text: Feels bad about taking penny off offerings

indicators.note: off tells us the penny is removed from the gifts word

parts.note: offerings are gifts, presents

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles at having a coin taken from the collection plate.
explanation.definitionFit: To take umbrage at something is to feel aggrieved about it.

clue.text: For one, matter may involve end of life

definitions.text: For one, matter may involve end of life

parts.words: For one, matter may involve end of life
parts.note: a person settling an affair of honour by single combat, whose quarrel may end in someone's death; 'For one' hints at the one-on-one fight

explanation.definitionFit: A combatant in a formal fight with pistols or swords risked death to settle a point of honour.

clue.text: Change round seat, dreadfully hot in awful factory

indicators.note: round says the exchange word goes around the remaining pieces

parts.note: to swop (a variant spelling of swap) is to change one thing for another

indicators.note: dreadfully signals that the letters of seat are jumbled

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone moves a chair in a horribly hot, grim workplace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' looks like a verb acting on the seat, but it is the swapping word, here in its older spelling with an O.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweatshop is a factory with harsh conditions and low pay, so an awful place to work.

clue.text: Cuban measure of alcohol upset sailor

parts.note: rum is an alcoholic spirit

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the sailor letters are turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor knocks over a tot of Caribbean liquor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'measure' means a dance, not a quantity of drink; 'upset' turns AB into BA.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a dance from Cuba, and a measure is an old word for a dance.

clue.text: He provides the band for union celebration

definitions.text: He provides the band for union celebration

parts.words: He provides the band for union celebration
parts.note: at a wedding (a union) one man hands over the ring (a band); it reads like someone hiring musicians for a party

explanation.definitionFit: The groom's chief attendant traditionally keeps the wedding ring and produces it during the ceremony.

clue.text: One imparting knowledge of rough terrain

indicators.note: rough suggests the letters of terrain are roughed up into a new order

explanation.surface: A guide teaches people how to cross wild country.
explanation.definitionFit: A coach or instructor teaches skills to others.

clue.text: A way to pay for certain things with regularity

parts.note: in betting a banker is a certainty, a sure thing
order means regularity, orderliness

explanation.surface: Someone describes a method of settling routine bills on schedule.
explanation.walkthrough: A banker's order is the British term for a standing order, an instruction to a bank to pay a fixed sum regularly.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an instruction to a bank to make repeated payments, a payment method.

clue.text: Before going after gold, saint is ascetic

indicators.note: going after says the word for before comes later than the other pieces

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: A holy man shuns gold to live a life of self-denial.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe a severe, self-denying way of living without luxury.

clue.text: Unfortunate circumstances changed his plans around

indicators.note: around says the plans word wraps the other letters

parts.note: maps are plans or charts

indicators.note: changed signals the letters of his are rearranged

explanation.surface: Bad luck forced someone to rework their arrangements.
explanation.definitionFit: Accidents and bits of bad luck are unfortunate events.

clue.text: Support a big weight, an individual best

parts.note: to second is to support, as a motion
a ton is a large unit of weight
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: A weightlifter's personal best is holding up a heavy load.
explanation.definitionFit: Being beaten by nobody means being the finest of all.

clue.text: Small ruler used in making letters

indicators.note: used in says the answer lies within the run of letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A small measuring rule helps someone draw out letters neatly.
explanation.definitionFit: A diminutive monarch is a petty king governing a little realm.

clue.text: A lot of rupees worker collected for a year's work

indicators.note: collected means the rupee sum has taken in the worker

parts.note: a lac (lakh) is one hundred thousand rupees
a man is a worker, as in a hired hand

explanation.surface: Someone earns a fortune in Indian currency for a full year of labour.
explanation.walkthrough: A lac or lakh is the Indian word for 100,000.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an annual publication, a book covering one year.

clue.text: Pipe up, as one starting the day

definitions.meaning: a vertical pipe carrying water or gas upwards in a building
a person who gets out of bed in the morning, as in an early bird

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses name something that goes upwards: a vertical pipe and a person getting up.

clue.text: Batsman's aggressive plan causing unaccountable harm

definitions.meaning: in cricket and baseball, striking the ball and setting off at once for a run
describing an accident where the driver injures someone and flees

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names both a bold batting tactic and an accident whose driver flees without answering for it.

clue.text: Measured response from military stronghold at flier going over

indicators.note: going over in a down clue places the bird above the other pieces

parts.note: a tit is a small bird, a flier
a fort is a military stronghold

explanation.surface: A bird flies above a garrison, provoking a calculated reply.
explanation.definitionFit: Retaliation in kind is a proportionate reply, equal blow for blow.

clue.text: Present put in awkward position

definitions.meaning: being there at the scene, at hand
placed in difficulty, forced to answer

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both being at the scene and being put under pressure to respond immediately.

clue.text: Finished with husband in depression

indicators.note: in places the husband letter inside the depression word

parts.note: a trough is a low area or depression

explanation.surface: Someone is done with a spouse who is feeling low.
explanation.definitionFit: Being done with something means having completed it.

clue.text: Time of day when tea, say, is unavailable during horse trials

indicators.note: is unavailable during means this letter is missing from within the horse trials word

parts.note: eventing is the equestrian sport of horse trials
T is the letter whose name sounds like tea

explanation.surface: At a horse show, there is no tea served at a certain hour.
explanation.walkthrough: Eventing is the equestrian competition combining dressage, cross-country and showjumping; removing T leaves the time of day.
explanation.definitionFit: The later part of the day, after afternoon, is a time of day.

clue.text: During Lent, for example, start to envisage this?

definitions.text: During Lent, for example, start to envisage this?

indicators.note: During says the starting letter sits inside the fasting word

parts.note: Lent is an example of a fast

indicators.note: start to means take the first letter of envisage

explanation.surface: A hungry believer daydreams of a banquet while giving things up for Lent.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a fast-deprived person dreams of a big meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A lavish banquet is just what someone abstaining from food would dream of.

clue.text: Criminal seizes excellent porcelain

indicators.note: seizes means the criminal word grabs and holds the excellent letters

parts.note: a fence is a criminal who handles stolen goods
A1 (written AI) means first-rate, excellent

explanation.surface: A crook grabs some fine china.
explanation.definitionFit: Faience is glazed ceramic ware, loosely called porcelain or fine pottery.

clue.text: Very silly group of ladies dancing as I come over

indicators.note: come over in a down clue puts the first pieces above the number

parts.note: taken as written
the carol The Twelve Days of Christmas has nine ladies dancing

explanation.surface: Someone thinks a troupe of dancing women looks absurd as they arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: Asinine means donkey-like, foolish, extremely stupid.

clue.text: The most black risks at end of gambit — king stuck in middle

indicators.note: stuck in middle means the king letter is lodged inside the risks word

parts.note: dares means risks, ventures
K is the chess abbreviation for king

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of gambit

explanation.surface: A chess player's darkest moment comes when the king gets trapped mid-board after a gambit.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of dark means the blackest, having the least light.

clue.text: About noon, cat runs off into shade

indicators.note: About says the cat word goes around the noon letter
off means the runs letter is removed from the cat word

parts.note: a tiger is a big cat
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: At midday a cat darts away into the shadows.
explanation.walkthrough: TIGER loses R to give TIGE, which goes around N.
explanation.definitionFit: A tinge is a slight tint, a shade of colour.

clue.text: There's nothing to restrict the view

parts.note: O is the round figure zero, nothing
to pinion is to restrict, tie down the arms

explanation.surface: Nothing blocks the scenery from sight.
explanation.definitionFit: A view in the sense of a belief or judgement is a held belief.

clue.text: Island gathering?

definitions.meaning: an island in the Indian Ocean, a French overseas department
a meeting of people coming together again

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a French island east of Madagascar and a get-together of former associates.

clue.text: Stress in musical group is returning

indicators.note: returning means the whole combination is read backwards
in puts the word is inside the musical group

parts.note: a nonet is a group of nine musicians
taken as written

explanation.surface: Strain builds within a band on its return.
explanation.walkthrough: A nonet is the nine-player counterpart of a quartet or quintet; 'in' places the next piece inside and 'returning' turns the whole result round.
explanation.definitionFit: Stress and strain are near-synonyms for mental or physical pressure.

clue.text: Challenge whether goose is cooked

indicators.note: cooked signals the letters of the two words are mixed together

explanation.surface: A diner asks if the Christmas bird is done yet.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the sentry's call demanding identity, a challenge.
